notes: v5.4 — the AI routes release: (1) ChatGPT/Codex and Gemini CLI runs are fixed at the root (no more trusted-directory / stdin failures) and CLI errors are readable, never code fragments. (2) Gemini's retired default model is gone — the panel moves to a working model automatically, saves it, and Test & Save now proves the connection with a real test call. (3) Local (Ollama) uses a model you actually have installed. (4) Font Finder tries every vision route you have instead of failing on the first. (5) Calm errors: retries show as one quiet status line; if everything fails you get ONE plain-language message — details wait in Settings -> Diagnostics. (6) Text Animations: a build After Effects accepts is never rejected by the panel again, the failing step is named in Diagnostics, and a fallback build keeps animations applying. (7) NEW in-panel Help Desk (footer + Settings) — message us on Instagram, copy diagnostics in one tap. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
